name: Wren Manor
tagline: The command center for the artisans who compose once-in-a-lifetime days.
positioning: Wren Manor unifies inquiries, contracts, timelines, and payments so solo wedding pros can run a boutique studio like an estate.

hero.h1: Run your wedding studio like a grand estate, not a spreadsheet.
hero.sub: Wren Manor gathers every inquiry, contract, timeline, and final payment into one serene workspace — so a single photographer, planner, or florist can perform like a full house.

features.title: The Inquiry Gallery
features.description: Every couple who reaches out lands in one warm inbox with source, date, and budget — no more losing a June bride between Instagram DMs and email.

features.title: Contracts & signatures
features.description: Send a branded proposal, contract, and deposit invoice as one document. Couples sign and pay in a single sitting, and it lands signed in their file.

features.title: The Day-Of Timeline
features.description: Compose ceremony-to-send-off timelines that sync to every vendor and the couple, so nobody asks 'when is golden hour?' at the reception.

features.title: Payment schedules
features.description: Automate deposit, midpoint, and final balance reminders. Wren Manor chases the overdue invoice so you can stay the artist, not the accountant.

features.title: The Couple's Portal
features.description: Give each client a private, elegant home for questionnaires, mood boards, and their signed paperwork — branded entirely to your studio.

features.title: Booking pipeline
features.description: See every lead move from inquiry to booked to delivered on one refined board, with revenue forecast for the season ahead.

testimonials.quote: I shot 41 weddings solo last year and Wren Manor is the only reason I still sleep. Inquiries, contracts, and final payments finally live in one place.
testimonials.name: Marisol Trench

testimonials.quote: The couple's portal made me look like a ten-person agency. Clients think I have an assistant. I have Wren Manor.
testimonials.name: Devon Ashby

testimonials.quote: Automated payment reminders recovered almost four thousand dollars in late balances my old spreadsheet quietly forgot about.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

homepage.footerBlurb: Wren Manor is the quiet operating system behind independent wedding artisans — turning scattered inquiries into unforgettable, beautifully run days.
